shared_elements: bearded male figures with elaborately patterned hair/headdress
figures with one arm raised/extended forward
low relief frieze arranged in a single horizontal register
figures aligned along a common groundline
justification: Both surfaces show a horizontal frieze of strictly profile, bearded male figures in low relief with the same conventions of finely incised hair, beard and patterned drapery, arms extended forward at chest height along a shared groundline. The subjects differ substantially, however: A centres on an enthroned figure holding a bowl attended by a standing servant with a staff, while B is a procession of attendants leading horned rams beside a stylised tree with rosette-band borders and no seated figure or animals in common.
